7856.title: Workflow selected-only model diagnostics
7856.rootCauseOneLine: Cursor's configured primary-model list puts other advertised models in selectedOnlyModels; workflow literal validation searches only models and emits an unexplained mismatch for an otherwise known model.
7856.proposedFix: Explain default-catalog restrictions and existing customModels registration for known selected-only literal selections; document inheritance without changing eligibility policy.
7856.caveats: Reproduced the validator diagnostic with a repository-derived fixture, not a live Cursor session. Exact external catalog counts and reported provider versions remain unverified.
